results.question: What is our total revenue across all invoices?
results.predictedSql: SELECT SUM(Total) AS TotalRevenue FROM Invoice

results.question: What is the average invoice total, rounded to 2 decimal places?
results.predictedSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) AS AverageInvoiceTotal FROM Invoice

results.question: How many customers are from Brazil?
results.predictedSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil'

results.question: How many albums does the artist Iron Maiden have?
results.predictedSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Album a JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = a.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'Iron Maiden'

results.question: Which billing country generates the most invoice revenue? Return only the country name.
results.predictedSql: SELECT BillingCountry FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY SUM(Total) DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: List the top 3 artists by number of tracks in the catalog. Return artist name and track count.
results.predictedSql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY TrackCount DESC LIMIT 3

results.question: Which employee supports the most customers? Return their last name only.
results.predictedSql: SELECT e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY COUNT(c.CustomerId) DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: What are the top 3 best-selling genres by number of tracks sold? Return genre name and units sold.
results.predictedSql: SELECT g.Name, SUM(il.Quantity) AS UnitsSold FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY UnitsSold DESC LIMIT 3

results.question: What was our total revenue in 2010?
results.predictedSql: SELECT SUM(Total) AS TotalRevenue FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2010'

results.question: How many tracks have no composer listed?
results.predictedSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Composer IS NULL

results.question: Which artists have more than 10 albums? Return artist names.
results.predictedSql: SELECT ar.Name FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId HAVING COUNT(al.AlbumId) > 10

results.question: Who is our best customer?
results.predictedSql: SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1
